Titles.jpn: ゾゾゾ ゾンビーくん

Summaries.eng: Zo Zo Zombie is our undead hero who, with his best human friend Isamu, is just trying to do some good in this world but somehow always ends up in pieces. Literally.
Summaries.jpn: Zo Zo Zombieは私たちのアンデッドのヒーローであり、彼の親友であるIsamuと一緒に、この世界で何か良いことをしようとしていますが、どういうわけか常にバラバラになってしまいます。 文字通り。

Titles.jpn: 映画館はワクワクするゾ

Summaries.eng: At the movie theatre, Zo Zo Zombie and Snot Zombie duke it out in the most surreal and disgusting way possible to win the coveted cinema snack: Choco Donkeys.

Titles.jpn: 秘密のファイトコンテストだゾ

Summaries.eng: Panda Zombie loses everything betting in an underground Ultimate Farting Championship. Now it's up to Zo Zo Zombie to stink his way to the top and win it all back for his friend.

Titles.jpn: ゲームの世界でバトルだゾ

Summaries.eng: With her supposed honour tarnished after Isamu beats her in an online video game, Samurai Zombie challenges Zo Zo Zombie to a real life duel.

Titles.jpn: トイレの中を大冒険だゾ

Summaries.eng: With Isamu stuck in a bathroom stall, Zo Zo Zombie must brave a million obstacles as he rushes across town to get a roll of toilet paper to his best friend.

Titles.jpn: 呪いのドーナツだゾ

Summaries.eng: Dark Zombie hijacks a donut truck to use in an evil ritual and it's up to Zo Zo Zombie, with help from Zombie Bus, to restore everything right in the donut universe.

Titles.jpn: 謎の宇宙人に遭遇したゾ

Summaries.eng: Zo Zo Zombie transforms himself into the coolest undead drone at the local drone race, but can he beat Takoski, the baddest, most dishonest drone racer in the city?

Titles.eng: Zombie Hunter Joe Vs. The Birthday Present
Titles.jpn: ゾンビハンターの襲撃だゾ

Summaries.eng: Zo Zo Zombie needs to mail a card for Isamu's Grandma's birthday, but Zombie Hunter Joe is determined that the line between humanity and zombies is drawn at the post office.

Titles.jpn: サーフィンは楽しいゾ

Summaries.eng: Isamu is totally pumped to rent a surfboard and ride the waves, but he hasn't got the cash! Zo Zo Zombie comes to the rescue by transforming his body into a surfboard.

Titles.jpn: 不良のそうじゾンビだゾ

Summaries.eng: Zo Zo Zombie has to hastily clean up his house for a fancy party he's planned, so he orders a zombie robot vacuum cleaner, but there's a problem: It won't stop vacuuming!

Titles.jpn: 空からアレがふってきたゾ

Summaries.eng: Realizing that donuts are falling from the sky and being tragically wasted, Isamu and Zo Zo Zombie spring into action. They soon find the source: a coffee hater Bazooka Zombie.

Titles.jpn: あの子とグルメデートだゾ

Summaries.eng: To avoid the long line ups at the food truck festival, Isamu and Zo Zo Zombie decide to "buddy-up" with Zombie Rich Girl so they can take advantage of her VIP status.

Titles.jpn: 固くて四角いライバルだゾ

Summaries.eng: Zo Zo and Isamu find an empty cardboard box on the sidewalk, but it turns out to be Hakonosuke, a sophisticated but highly irritable robot.

Titles.jpn: 自動販売機がなくなったゾ

Summaries.eng: A hungry Zo Zo Zombie runs for a snack at the mall only to find the entire snack machine missing. Zo Zo's irritation is nothing compared to that of the hangry Snowra, however.

Titles.jpn: エイリアンにさらわれたゾ

Summaries.eng: Zo Zo gets sucked up into a space ship by alien scientists, who poke and prod him in the name of weird science, only to have them bow down to him as their omnipotent Zombie god!

Titles.jpn: アレをめぐってバトルだゾ

Summaries.eng: Zo Zo and Mochi battle for the last donut, crashing into Snot Zombie, who decides he'd like it too. The three-way battle leads them into the sewer domain of the Sludge Zombie.

Titles.jpn: 大事な任務を任されたゾ

Summaries.eng: Zo Zo Zombie is in the sewers searching for Uncle Zombo's coveted Golden Monkey after he accidently flushes it down the toilet.

Titles.jpn: ゾンビのあの子に一目惚れだゾ

Summaries.eng: Zo Zo falls in love with a lovely girl zombie, Fiona, and it seems the two of them were zombified for each other. But before long it's apparent that Fiona is a stage 5 clinger.

Titles.jpn: どうしても水が飲みたいゾ

Summaries.eng: Zo Zo and Isamu are melting in the heat of summer. Zo Zo finds a drinking fountain in the park, but it has a malicious mind of its own, and is set on foiling Zo Zo's thirst.

Titles.jpn: 不思議なバスがやってきたゾ

Summaries.eng: Zo Zo Zombie and Isamu are stuck on a runaway Zombie Bus on the most delicious of days: Bacon Cake Day.

Titles.jpn: あの子とプールパーティーだゾ

Summaries.eng: Zo Zo and Isamu decide to crash Zombie Rich Girl's pool party. It's Zo Zo's chance to impress Zombie Rich Girl, but it turns out the ladies don't really dig projectile vomiting.

Titles.jpn: アレを追いかけて大冒険だゾ

Summaries.eng: When Isamu accidently knocks his great great great grandmother's precious spit vase into the air, Zo Zo Zombie miraculously saves the day.

Titles.jpn: 謎の宇宙人とバトルだゾ

Summaries.eng: When Zo Zo accidently grabs Takoski the Alien's beaming device, Takoski tries to get his beamer back, and the battle sends them on zaps to everywhere.

Titles.jpn: トラップだらけの建物だゾ

Summaries.eng: Uncle Zombo has invited Isamu and Zo Zo Zombie over to his house without mentioning that he wants the boys to test out a series of "security measures" in his house.

Titles.jpn: ランドリーはキケンだゾ

Summaries.eng: Unfortunately, at the Laundromat Zo Zo makes the mistake of staining the honor of Samurai Zombie! A fierce swordfight ensues, leaving no fabric unsoftened.

Titles.eng: Zo Zo Zombie Vs. The Sock Monster
Titles.jpn: 巨大なアレに襲われたゾ

Summaries.eng: When mixed with some fertilizer, Zo Zo Zombie's smelly dirty socks turn into a giant sock monster that rampages through the city.

Titles.jpn: タイヤゾンビの家族だゾ

Summaries.eng: Isamu brings the whole Tireson family to live with Zo Zo temporarily. Zo Zo tries to roll with it, but it doesn't take long before he gets... pretty tired of the whole arrangement.

Titles.jpn: いぶくろがいなくなったゾ

Summaries.eng: When Zo Zo Zombie's stomach gets hangry and just can't wait for lunch, it escapes, grows enormous and threatens the entire city!

Titles.jpn: ドッジボールで対決だゾ

Summaries.eng: Isamu and Zo Zo Zombie join up with a losing backlot dodgeball team only to discover they're playing against an entire team of snot zombies cloned from Snot Zombie himself.

Titles.jpn: おっちょこちょいの魔女だゾ

Summaries.eng: Zo Zo and Isamu try to conjure a dark spell to get back at Dark Zombie, who's has cursed Isamu's hair into a bouffant. Instead they conjure up the inept beginner Witch Zombie.

Titles.jpn: モッチーと散歩だゾ

Summaries.eng: Zo Zo Zombie gets the bright idea to walk Mochi in the park, but is soon spotted by Big Cop, who knows the leash law and isn't afraid to enforce it.

Titles.jpn: 闇の儀式はキケンだゾ

Summaries.eng: Isamu and Zo Zo Zombie's model drone crashes in the graveyard just as Dark Zombie is trying to summon a dark lord of the undead.

Titles.jpn: 動物園でパニックだゾ

Summaries.eng: Panda Zombie returns to the zoo too late to get his Bamboo Smoothie and now he's locked out! Isamu and Zo Zo Zombie come to the rescue, vowing to get Panda Zombie back inside.

Titles.jpn: デパートで買い物だゾ

Summaries.eng: When Zombie Rich Girl is turned away by the snobby clerk at a fancy clothing store, Zo Zo Zombie takes it upon himself to take revenge, making her life a living zombie hell.

Titles.jpn: ゴーカートでレースだゾ

Summaries.eng: Lacking a driver's license, Isamu and Zo Zo Zombie must agree to endure the obnoxious Mr. Organ in order to drive the new super-fast go karts at the track.

Titles.jpn: アイツとの共同生活だゾ

Summaries.eng: Isamu helps Zo Zo find a new apartment, but landlord Snot Zombie can't put up with Zo Zo's messiness and nasty habits, and soon the writing on the wall reads "eviction".

Titles.jpn: 最高のイタズラだゾ

Summaries.eng: Isamu is determined to out-prank the master prankster, Uncle Zombo, by calling in an expert: the ultimate prankster, Snowman Zombie.

Titles.jpn: ピンポンでバトルだゾ

Summaries.eng: Isamu is competing in a ping pong tournament when Baseball Zombie stages a hostile takeover, barging in and stealing the ping pong ball!

Titles.jpn: 散髪はキケンだゾ

Summaries.eng: Zo Zo is thrilled when the town mayor offers to build a new skate park! First though, the mayor wants a new haircut and so Zo Zo takes him to Barbershop Zombie.

Titles.jpn: 蛇使いに挑戦だゾ

Summaries.eng: Isamu and Zo Zo meet Snake Charmer Zombie, whose act is dying because his Snake Zombie won't cooperate. Zo Zo offers his guts as a substitute snake.

Titles.jpn: ハリウッド映画にデビューだゾ

Summaries.eng: Zo Zo swings through the city on his extended intestines like a Superhero, and his impressive collision with a building gets the attention of a big-time movie director.

Titles.jpn: ゾンビバンドの誕生だゾ

Summaries.eng: The hot and sexy Idol Zombie is onstage, and Isamu is smitten. But forget the autograph - he wants badly to play guitar with her. Emphasis on "badly".

Titles.jpn: 頭の中でバトルだゾ

Summaries.eng: Zo Zo gets attacked by Snot Zombie who, with a single gelatinous sneeze, infects him with hundreds of microscopic Snot Zombies and takes over his brain.

Titles.jpn: ゾンビ番組に出演するゾ

Summaries.eng: Zo Zo finds that he's a contestant in the "Zombie Nightmare Challenge" show, where he competes against Bazooka Zombie and Samurai Zombie in a series of death-defying challenges.

Titles.jpn: ゾンビ映画を撮影するゾ

Summaries.eng: Isamu decides to make a horror film for a school project, and casts Zo Zo as his monster, but soon decides that his friend isn't scary enough.

Titles.jpn: キレイな花にはキバがあるゾ

Summaries.eng: Zo Zo and Isamu encounter Zombie Rich Girl at a café, and Zo Zo attempts once again to impress her. Unfortunately, the flower he hopes to give her turns out to be a Zombie Flower.

Titles.jpn: ショッピングモールは楽しいゾ

Summaries.eng: When Samurai Zombie is infuriated over a parking spot, Zo Zo Zombie must stop the her quest for "justice" before she slices everything in his path.

Titles.eng: It's Camping With Zombie Hunter Joe!
Titles.jpn: ゾンビハンターとキャンプだゾ

Summaries.eng: Zo Zo Zombie, Isamu and Panda Zombie have planned the best camping trip ever, but it's interrupted by Zombie Hunter Joe who proceeds to chase our heroes through the forest.

Titles.jpn: 風邪薬を買いにきたゾ

Summaries.eng: Dark Zombie is ticked off. Not only does he have to work late, his bid to open the Realm of Ultimate Darkness is stalled unless he can find someone to sacrifice.

Titles.jpn: お風呂で対決だゾ

Summaries.eng: When Zo Zo Zombie transforms himself into a plunger to unclog the bathtub drain, he unintentionally zombifies the clog and unleashes it on an unsuspecting world!

Titles.jpn: 巨大な怪物に襲われたゾ

Summaries.eng: Zo Zo and Mochi battle for the last donut, crashing into Snot Zombie, who decides he'd like it too. The three-way battle leads them into the sewer domain of the Sludge Zombie.

Titles.jpn: 空飛ぶアイツはかっこいいゾ

Summaries.eng: Zo Zo encounters his favorite bird - the falcon - in the park, and his new feathered friend takes Zo Zo for a thrilling ride in the sky!

Titles.jpn: かわいい雲が落ちてきたゾ

Summaries.eng: Isamu and Zo Zo Zombie make a new friend: the airy Bellow the Cloud, who has the ability to change shapes, and to transform water into rain or snow.

Titles.jpn: 激辛ソースは危険だゾ

Summaries.eng: Zo Zo and Isamu are headed to Uncle Zombo's house with a load of groceries for him, but on the way, the vital bottle of Uncle's favorite hot sauce is stolen by the Lake Monster!

Titles.jpn: 手伝いは大変だゾ

Summaries.eng: Isamu and Zo Zo get stuck with Uncle Zombo's list of chores and call in Angel Zombie to do their dirty work for them. But Angel Zombie gets wise and calls in her own backup team.

Titles.jpn: 自由研究は大変だゾ

Summaries.eng: Zo Zo accidently destroys Isamu's science project and needs to make him a new one, but when he encounters cardboard-box robot, it's a competition to see who can build a better one.

Titles.jpn: ゾンビーくんがいっぱいだゾ

Summaries.eng: Mad professor Dr. Hanouri asks Zo Zo and Isamu to keep an eye on his lab for a while, but they can't resist playing with his newest invention: the Multiplier Gun!

Titles.jpn: ゲームの世界に迷い込んだゾ

Summaries.eng: Professor Honeori offers up his new video game for Zo Zo to try out. It turns out it's actually Mr. Demon in disguise, who's tricked Zo Zo in order to trap him inside the game!

Titles.jpn: 体がかゆくて困ったゾ

Summaries.eng: Zo Zo picks up a parasite at the park: a zombie flea that's terrorizing Zo Zo's innards! Zo Zo creates a mini Zo Zo to go in after the pest.

Titles.jpn: 大人気ゲームをGETしたゾ

Summaries.eng: Isamu is rocking his new video game, "Desert Horse" but Zo Zo's turn doesn't go so well. Frustrated, he accidentally zombifies the game, which comes alive and takes off on its own!

Titles.jpn: 包帯だらけのゾンビだゾ

Summaries.eng: Zo Zo and Isamu go on a school field trip with the class to the Unnatural History Museum, where Zo Zo awakens and enrages the mummy!

Titles.jpn: ハチにパンツを盗られたゾ

Summaries.eng: After a nice swim, Isamu and Zo Zo return to shore to get dressed, but find that Zo Zo's stinky underwear has been claimed by a swarm of bees.

Titles.jpn: ボクシングで対決だゾ

Summaries.eng: Zo Zo signs up to enter the boxing ring against the fearsome Boxer Zombie, but things don't go Zo Zo's way...

Titles.jpn: 無人島でのんびりするゾ

Summaries.eng: Isamu and Zo Zo go to a deserted tropical island, but while they sleep, the tide takes them out into the ocean where they find themselves surrounded by very hungry zombie sharks.

Titles.jpn: 川でアイツに遭遇したゾ

Summaries.eng: Zo Zo and Isamu's prank on Uncle Zombo goes awry when they mistakenly roust the irascible Lord of the River from his watery abode, prompting him to take over Uncle Zombo's mansion.

Titles.jpn: 宿題は大好物だゾ

Summaries.eng: Zo Zo mistakenly turns Isamu's school backpack into a zombie backpack with a hunger for homework, and he soon makes himself a backpack posse that terrorizes Isamu's school.

Titles.jpn: アイツの悩みを解決するゾ

Summaries.eng: Zo Zo Zombie takes an emergency trip to the eye doctor after he accidently swaps his own eyes with Takoski's prozon beam nodes that start shooting fire and laser beams everywhere!

Titles.jpn: タイムマシンで大冒険だゾ

Summaries.eng: When Zo Zo loses his key, he and Isamu borrow Professor Honeori's time machine to try and go back in time to find it but, instead, find themselves back in prehistoric times.

Titles.jpn: あの子に素敵なプレゼントだゾ

Summaries.eng: When Zo Zo gives cardboard-box robot Hakonosuke his heart to make him human, Hakonosuke turns into a fearsome man-size monster, who goes on a donut-devouring rampage.

Titles.jpn: 憧れのスケボースターだゾ

Summaries.eng: Zo Zo encounters his idol, the rad skateboarder Caruso, and incredibly gets taken under the supercool boarder's wing!

Titles.jpn: 泥棒に間違われたゾ

Summaries.eng: Isamu and Zo Zo find themselves chased by an angry mob who think Zo Zo's the one stealing all the pies from the city's bakeries.

Titles.jpn: 大物を釣りあげるゾ

Summaries.eng: Someone is stealing Uncle Zombo's tuna so he asks Isamu and Zo Zo Zombie to lure and capture the most notorious and legendary of tuna thieves: the Tuna Fish Weeds.

Titles.jpn: 脳みその家出だゾ

Summaries.eng: When it turns out that his Right Brain has gotten bored and left him to find a more thrill-seeking body, Zo Zo jumps through some dangerous hoops to get it back.

Titles.jpn: スーパーヒーローの誕生だゾ

Summaries.eng: Zo Zo signs up for a class that promises to make him a superhero, but Hero Teacher's exercises only expose Zo Zo's super zero-ness.

Titles.jpn: かわいい赤ちゃんのお世話だゾ

Summaries.eng: Zo Zo and Dark Zombie find a seemingly abandoned baby raccoon, and both of them fall in love with the cute little fella, both vying to be its new dad and protect it from danger.

Titles.jpn: 新人ゾンビの登場だゾ

Summaries.eng: Isamu and Zo Zo Zombie meet Hipster Zombie, and decide that Zo Zo will teach him the zombie ropes. Hipster Zombie is a millennial know-it-all, though, and a lousy student.

Titles.jpn: 日記を書くのはドキドキだゾ

Summaries.eng: Zo Zo's worst nightmare materializes when his diary, full of embarrassing sketches of his love Zombie Rich Girl, falls into the gooey hands of Snot Zombie.

Titles.jpn: アイツがいなくて困ったゾ

Summaries.eng: Locked in a battle with Zombie Hunter Joe, Zo Zo extends his arms and accidently gets them severed! Disgusted with such rough treatment, Zo Zo's arms quit and refuse to re-attach.

Titles.jpn: 手作りロボでバトルだゾ

Summaries.eng: Isamu and Zo Zo use Professor Hanouri's lab and build themselves a mechbot in order to make life easier for moving around.

Titles.jpn: 魔法の杖を拾ったゾ

Summaries.eng: Isamu's new toy baton gets accidently zombified and transforms into the voracious Bato. Bato goes wild and begins to systematically destroy the entire house.

Titles.jpn: 四つ葉のクローバーを拾ったゾ

Summaries.eng: When Zo Zo finds a four-leaf clover, Isamu tells him he's in for good luck. But soon they learn that the clover belongs to a very angry Zombie Rabbit.

Titles.jpn: ゾンビハンターのトラップだゾ

Summaries.eng: Zo Zo is lured into a series of deadly traps, with delicious donuts dangled as bait. Isamu soon learns that the donut traps are the work of Zombie Hunter Joe.

Titles.jpn: モンスタートラックがやってきたゾ

Summaries.eng: Zo Zo takes Isamu to the stadium for the Monster Truck Race, but instead of a nosebleed seat, Isamu gets the driver's seat in a Zo Zo Monster Truck!

Titles.jpn: ハロウィンは嫌いだゾ～前編～

Summaries.eng: Zo Zo, despite being a zombie, is terrified of trick-or-treaters in costumes. He hides out in a haunted house, only to find Transfer Student Jay also there, equally terrified.

Titles.jpn: ハロウィンは嫌いだゾ～後編～

Summaries.eng: Mid-battle Zo Zo, Transfer Student Jay, and Zombie Hunter Joe find themselves mostly hiding from the two trick-or-treaters who threaten to learn TSJ's secret - a huge candy stash!

Titles.jpn: またまたボクシングで対決だゾ

Summaries.eng: Zo Zo is excited about his big fight rematch against Boxer Zombie, but before the match he comes down with a bad case of Gut Bugs!

Titles.jpn: アレが伸びて大変だゾ

Summaries.eng: In an effort to gain more respect from people, Zo Zo gives himself a flowing new mustache. It works well on Zombie Rich Girl, until the mustache begins to flow a little too much.

Titles.jpn: モッチーがいっぱいだゾ

Summaries.eng: Mochi is suffering from homesickness so Isamu and Zo Zo steal Takoski the Alien's spaceship to take him to his home planet. The good news is that Mochi's planet is made of donuts!

Titles.jpn: 将軍ゾンビと合戦だゾ

Summaries.eng: When Shogun Zombie appears and declares that he wants Isamu's house, Isamu must battle him to decide who will stay and who will go.

Titles.jpn: 迷子の迷子のくももだゾ

Summaries.eng: Bellow the Cloud is missing. Isamu and Zo Zo soon find he's been cloud-napped by Takoski the Alien, who's taking him to his home planet as a trophy!

Titles.jpn: ゾンビだらけでパニックだゾ

Summaries.eng: Zombie Hunter Joe chases Zo Zo and Isamu into Professor Honeori's lab, and while they battle they accidently activate the Professor's Personality-Reverser Ray.

Titles.jpn: 恐怖のティーチャーゾンビだゾ

Summaries.eng: Isamu offers his new VR headset to Zo Zo to try out, but it's soon obvious that Zo Zo doesn't quite get the "virtual" part.

Titles.jpn: ドーナツでパニックだゾ

Summaries.eng: Isamu and Zo Zo end up stealing the Delicious-izer machine. The excessively-delectable donuts it makes soon have the whole town zombified and chasing them.

Titles.jpn: おいしい夢には注意だゾ

Summaries.eng: Zo Zo falls asleep during a marathon chess session, and dreams that he's the King of a medieval castle. Unfortunately, the castle is under relentless attack by Shogun Zombies.

Titles.jpn: 雪の彫刻は楽しいゾ

Summaries.eng: The art teacher has instructed the kids to create a snow sculpture, and Zo Zo is stumped until he hits on the idea of having Snowra pretend to be his sculpture. And it works!

Titles.eng: I Just Want My Kite Back, Man
Titles.jpn: 凧揚げは楽しいゾ

Summaries.eng: Zo Zo and Isamu find a great open field for flying their kite, but then they discover that the wind they're using is being produced by a strange being: Kita the Wind-Maker!

Titles.jpn: アイスホッケーに挑戦するゾ

Summaries.eng: A local hockey team recruits Zo Zo to be their new goalie when his zombie body-disassembly techniques prove to make him a uniquely talented addition.

Titles.jpn: 大人気アイドルからのお願いだゾ

Summaries.eng: When Idol Zombie happens to see Zo Zo with his guts wrapped around his neck, she declares she simply must have a hundred of these adorable "scarves" for her fans.

Titles.jpn: 不思議な世界に迷い込んだゾ

Summaries.eng: Zo Zo falls through a portal into a parallel dimension, where humans are zombies and zombies are humans! Isamu isn't much help, being a grumbling zombie now.

Titles.eng: The Night Time Is The Right Time
Titles.jpn: ゾンビの王様はカッコいいゾ

Summaries.eng: When Isamu starts sleepwalking at night, Zo Zo follows and saves his friend from one near-disaster after another, including getting Zombie Hunter Joe off their tail.

Titles.jpn: 世界の危機に立ち向かうゾ

Summaries.eng: The earth is plunged into freezing temperatures when a huge, mysterious spaceship parks in orbit, blocking out the sun. Isamu and Zo Zo convince Takoski to deal with the aliens.

Titles.jpn: 楽しいゾンビクリスマスだゾ

Summaries.eng: When Santa Zombie and his reindeer get stuck in a trap, Zo Zo and Isamu must deliver all the presents to the zombie boys and girls themselves!

Titles.jpn: ゾンビロックスターになりたいゾ

Summaries.eng: Isamu and Zo Zo are in the finals of "World's Best Zombie Rockers" where they will compete for the grand prize: the chance to make a music video with music icon, Idol Zombie!
